title: Deadlock when quitting during pipeline compilation
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduciable in v4.6.1

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable.mono - Windows 11 (build 26200) - Multi-window, 3 monitors - Direct3D 12 (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.8180) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-14900K (32 threads) - 31.80 GiB memory

### Issue description

When using the multi threaded rendering, `WorkerThreadPool` might deadlock, if you call `GetTree().Quit(1);` while it is compiling a shader pipeline.

Order of events causing deadlock:
1. `GetTree().Quit(1);` is called.
2. Main thread enters `WorkerThreadPool::exit_languages_threads()`.
3. All threads enter/report back to `RUNLEVEL_PRE_EXIT_LANGUAGES`.
4. Worker thread 0 (RenderingServer Thread) starts new flush/draw (see call stack below).
5. Main thread moves forward and switches runlevel to `RUNLEVEL_EXIT_LANGUAGES` and enters the next loop to [wait for all threads to detach from scripting language](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c0ebded926fcec84a72656f8ff6d7f87a20064c2/core/object/worker_thread_pool.cpp#L854C2-L856C3).
6.  Worker thread 0 (RenderingServer Thread) enters `PipelineHashMapRD::compile_pipeline`, calls `WorkerThreadPool::add_template_task`, which in turn ends up in `WorkerThreadPool::_post_tasks`. It finally reaches the [`while (runlevel == RUNLEVEL_EXIT_LANGUAGES)`](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/c0ebded926fcec84a72656f8ff6d7f87a20064c2/core/object/worker_thread_pool.cpp#L240C2-L242C3) loop.
7. Now the main thread is indefinetly waiting for the remaining thread to exit, while the remaining worker thread 0 is indefinetly waiting for the runlevel to change.

It appears the underlying issue is, that the rendering thread is still able to post a new task while run level is already at `RUNLEVEL_PRE_EXIT_LANGUAGES` or `RUNLEVEL_EXIT_LANGUAGES`.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable multi threaded rendering.
2.  `GetTree().Quit(1);` right in the first frame
3. Have enough nodes in the scene to get the timing right 🫠

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Here's a repro project. To enforce the bug you have to change the engine by adding a `OS::get_singleton()->delay_usec(500'000);` at this line [worker_thread_pool.cpp#L851](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/bfbe95e510a82f8db6e56220b268ca5945b726fd/core/object/worker_thread_pool.cpp#L851)
